key_decisions.decision: Title watch and murder threat explicit; sagab height retained.
Preserve claimed innocence in this conflict, not universal sinlessness.
Keep scope widening from local attackers to nations and refusal of mercy.
Keep pinned his strength rather than harmonizing to my strength in verse 17; note ellipsis.
Follow read my love; no added delight or triumph in look upon.
Preserve do not kill despite subsequent consume; no smoothing tension.
Keep doubled consume and shifting they without specifying survivors.

Keep my strength distinct from verse 9 and repeated stronghold/love.
